description: This file defines the Order class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Sale namespace. It contains methods for retrieving individual order details and multiple orders, including filtering and sorting capabilities, from the Opencart e-commerce platform database.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents the Sale Order model in OpenCart's administration module. It provides methods to retrieve order details and lists of orders from the database.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents the Sale Order model in OpenCart's administration module, providing methods for retrieving detailed order information, filtering, and managing orders.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific order identified by $order_id, including customer info, address details, order status, total, and other metadata.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders based on filtering criteria such as order status, date range, total, store, customer, and sorting options. Supports pagination.

methods.name: getOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves all orders associated with a given subscription ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the total count of orders associated with a given subscription ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByProductId
methods.description: Calculates the total quantity ordered for a specific product across all orders.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a specific order product.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches subscription details related to a specific order and product.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Returns all vouchers associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getVoucherByVoucherId
methods.description: Retrieves voucher details for a specific voucher ID.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Gets total details related to an order, including total amounts, taxes, and others.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Counts total orders based on various filtering criteria.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Counts total orders with a specific order status ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProcessingStatus
methods.description: Counts total orders in the processing status, based on configured statuses.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCompleteStatus
methods.description: Counts total orders with complete status, based on configured statuses.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByStoreId
methods.description: Counts total orders for a specific store.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByOrderId
methods.description: Counts total orders with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCustomerId
methods.description: Counts total orders for a specific customer.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByLanguageId
methods.description: Counts total orders associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCurrencyId
methods.description: Counts total orders in a specific currency.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Calculates total sales amount filtered by various criteria such as order status.

methods.name: createInvoiceNo
methods.description: Generates a new invoice number for an order, ensuring sequential invoice numbers per prefix, and updates the order record.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Returns the total reward points associated with an order.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the list of order history updates, including dates, statuses, comments, and notifications.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history records for a given order.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Returns the total number of history records for a specific order status.

methods.name: getEmailsByProductsOrdered
methods.description: Retrieves distinct emails associated with orders containing specified products, supporting pagination.

methods.name: getTotalEmailsByProductsOrdered
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of distinct emails associated with orders containing specified products.

search-terms: Filtering orders by date and total
